product.title: Premium Oahu Circle Island Tour – Small Group, No Crowds

description.text: A small-group coach of no more than 14 passengers circles Oahu after pickup at a Waikiki hotel. The day includes Diamond Head, the Halona Blowhole, Nu'uanu Pali Lookout, and Haleiwa Town. A stop at the Dole Plantation includes a whole Dole pineapple. The guide covers Oahu history during the ride. Pickup at the Waikiki hotel is part of that 14-passenger circle. Diamond Head, the Halona Blowhole, Nu'uanu Pali Lookout, Haleiwa Town, and the Dole pineapple stop are the named pieces of this small-group circle from Waikiki.
